description: Get the most recent global news articles from Currents (70k+ sources). Filter by language and category. Example: latest_news({ language: "en", category: "technology", limit: 15 })

_apiKey.description: Optional Currents API key (get one free at currentsapi.services). Omit to use the platform key.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. "technology", "business", "world", "sports". Use list_categories to see all options.

limit.description: Max number of articles to return (default 15, max 30).

name: latest_news
title: Latest News
